note: Wave one of the 4 Sep 2026 10.04 PM WhatsApp export (149 photographs, ten teams — see batch-0904c-research.md). This wave covers only the five clubs that had NO listing on the store at all: Atletico Madrid, Sporting CP, Al-Nassr, Borussia Dortmund and Celtic. Photo keys are p1..p149 in the export's timestamp order, staged by scripts/stage-0904c.py, and are the same numbers the research document uses.
identificationMethod: Every listing here is grouped by three things agreeing. (1) The client captions each photo with its garment type. (2) The export's file timestamps group photos to the SECOND, and the chat's caption order is reliable across seconds — so a second-group bounds which captions can apply to which photos. Within a single second the '(1)'/'(2)' suffix is WhatsApp's download-collision naming, NOT chat order, so it is never used to order anything. (3) The photographs themselves settle what remains. On the two Nike pairs the neck label was decisive and legible: DRI-FIT is the fan version, AERO-FIT the player version — that is how p135/p137 and p138/p139 were assigned, and it agrees independently with the caption order.
dedupeNote: None of these five clubs has a single listing on the live storefront, verified against the storefront product list on 5 Sep 2026, so there is nothing here to collide with. The one duplicate INSIDE the batch was found by eye: p141 and p148 are the same black Visit Rwanda half-zip set photographed twice at slightly different crops, so they are one listing carrying both photographs rather than two listings. Perceptual hashing is not used — it does not work on flat-lay garment photography against a plain backdrop.
assumptions: Two fan-versus-player calls could not be resolved and are flagged. In both, the two garments are DIFFERENT kits rather than one kit in two specs, so the choice changes which shirt carries which price. Sporting: the second-group holds p116 (dark green) and p117 (green and white hoops) against captions 'player version, fan version'. Celtic: the second-group holds p131 (dark away) and p132 (hooped home) against 'player, fan'. In both cases the hooped home is listed as the fan version and the darker shirt as the player version, because the home shirt is the higher-volume line. Both are a one-line correction if the client reads them the other way.
priceNote: The client's own tier table, as applied to the whole catalogue by scripts/apply-client-pricing.mjs. Long sleeve is the client's '+R100 if available', so retro long sleeve is R800 and player long sleeve R750. Training set is R600, matching the 0904b batch; the client's list carries both R600 and R700 wording for training sets and that ambiguity is still open. NOTHING in this wave is a full-zip tracksuit — those are held for wave two because the client has not priced them.
seasonNote: A season is asserted only where the shirt itself carries the sponsor or design that dates it. Atletico's current home and away both carry Riyadh Air, which has been the sponsor across more than one season, so they are titled by colourway rather than claiming a year the photograph cannot support.
